ayahs.translation: By the fig and the olive
And by this land made safe

ayahs.text: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: Surely We created man of the best stature
Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low

ayahs.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
ayahs.translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing
So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment
Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges
